verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Hoppscotch publishing a downloadable machine-readable spec of its own API, and probes of the common OpenAPI paths all returned 404. Importing OpenAPI files into collections, the llms.txt docs index, the MCP server and the CLI are adjacent features, not a published spec for Hoppscotch's own API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
